service.description: Whether find#PartyDuplicates would find a duplicate, by identification, email, birthday and name, or a similar name (find#PartyNameMatches). Personal contacts (Party.privateOwnerUserId) are left out of the duplicate scan: such a party has no duplicates, and is no other party's duplicate. A party marked not a duplicate of this one (mark#PartyNotDuplicate) is not one.

The parties that may be duplicates of a party, each with what matched, and the hasDuplicates and lastDupCheckDate flags of the party and those it matched set again. Reasons, each a matchType on the record: identification (the same id of the same type), email, birthDate (the same birthday, first and last name), phone (with the same first name or organization name), address (likewise) and name (a similar name, find#PartyNameMatches, with its nameScore). Personal contacts are left out, as the party and as a match, and so are disabled parties and the parties marked not duplicates of this one (mark#PartyNotDuplicate).

parameter.name: matchingInfoByPartyId
parameter.description: Key is partyId, value is List of records that match the other party including PartyIdentification, email, telecom number, and postal address, and for a similar name {partyId, matchType: 'name', nameScore, name}. Each record has a matchType: identification, email, birthDate, phone, address or name.

service.description: The directory parties with a name like a party's (partyId) or like the names given, each scored from 0 to 100, best first: the name reason of the duplicate scan (find#PartyDuplicates, find#PartyHasDuplicates), and a check for a similar contact before creating one. Names are compared normalized: case, accents and punctuation do not count, nor do an organization's legal suffixes (Inc, LLC, LLP, Ltd, Limited, GmbH, Co, Corp, Company, PLC, AG, SA, BV, Pty and the like) or a leading "The". A person matches on the last name, a Jaro-Winkler similarity of at least 0.9 (spaces left out, so "Van der Berg" is "Vanderberg"), and on the first name or nickname: the same (1), an initial of the other ("J." and "John") or its start ("Kim" and "Kimberly", three letters or more) (0.9), else a Jaro-Winkler similarity of at least 0.85; the score is 60% the last name's similarity and 40% the first name's. An organization matches on the bigram (Dice) similarity of its normalized name, 100 when they are the same. The candidates come from an index-friendly prefilter rather than a scan: a person's last name, or an organization's name (with and without "The"), starts with the same three characters, in the usual capitalizations and with or without accents, and a person's first name or nickname with the same letter. Personal contacts and disabled parties are never matches, nor, with partyId, a party marked not a duplicate of it (mark#PartyNotDuplicate).

parameter.name: partyId
parameter.description: The party whose names are matched; it is not its own match, and a personal contact has none

parameter.name: partyTypeEnumId
parameter.description: Without partyId: PtyPerson or PtyOrganization; empty is an organization when only organizationName is given

service.description: The parties marked not duplicates of a party (PartyNotDuplicate, the party on either side), latest first.

actions.script: const cf = ec.entity.conditionFactory const rows = Array.from(ec.entity.find('mantle.party.PartyNotDuplicate').condition(cf.makeCondition([ cf.makeCondition('partyId', 'equals', partyId), cf.makeCondition('otherPartyId', 'equals', partyId)], 'or')) .orderBy('-decidedDate').list()) notDuplicateList = rows.map((row) => ({otherPartyId: row.partyId === partyId ? row.otherPartyId : row.partyId, decidedByUserId: row.decidedByUserId, decidedDate: row.decidedDate, comments: row.comments})) otherPartyIdList = notDuplicateList.map((row) => row.otherPartyId)

service.description: Records that two directory parties are not duplicates (one PartyNotDuplicate row for the pair, whichever comes first; marking it again records who decided and when anew), then checks both again (find#PartyDuplicates), so their hasDuplicates flags no longer count each other and the scan leaves the pair out. Each party must be one the user may see: another user's personal contact is "not found", and the user's own personal contact is not in the duplicate scan at all. A disabled (merged or deleted) party cannot be marked.

Removes the decision that two parties are not duplicates (either order) and checks both again (find#PartyDuplicates), so the pair may be found again. Each party must be one the user may see, as for mark#PartyNotDuplicate.
